answer: Persistent attention island. Each identity must hold a distinct session slot on a monitored relay and answer randomized liveness challenges over weeks; only then does a small pearl of reputation unlock. Slots are capped per relay, so mass registration stalls on capacity. The kernel rule: missed or delegated challenges reset accumulated tenure. An attacker pays weeks of real-time upkeep per identity plus rented distinct network vantage, making farms linear-cost and slow to scale.
